Modern.tagline: Modern custom framing. Two parts named.
Modern.brandNameRationale: Rabbet is the L-shaped recess at the inside back of a frame that holds the artwork. Rail is the cross-bar of the stretcher behind a canvas. Two specific trade-vocabulary parts paired together — modern frame shop with a real craft-vocabulary anchor.
Modern.industrySummary: Modern picture framing has split between Michael's-grade big-box and museum-grade conservation. The opening is for a modern frame shop with explicit trade-vocabulary identity and conservation-grade materials at retail scale.
Modern.competitorLandscape: Simply Framed (simplyframed.com) holds the modern online-framing peer slot. Framebridge (framebridge.com) plays the at-scale direct-to-consumer peer. Level Frames (levelframes.com) is the modern frame-shop reference. We sit alongside Level Frames with sharper trade-vocabulary identity.
Modern.positioningStatement: A modern custom-frame shop with conservation-grade materials and a trade-vocabulary brand.

targetAudience.primary: 30 to 55. Owns several pieces of art. Frames slowly, one piece at a time, with intent.
behaviors: Brings the piece to the shop in person
Frames one piece every six months

dos: Name the rabbet depth and rail thickness
Treat the order like a software changelog

Modern.logoDirection: A wordmark only — Rabbet & Rail in a precise grotesk with a small frame-corner silhouette as a hallmark on the order receipt.

typography.primary: GT America for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: GT America Mono for material specifications
typography.rationale: One family. Mono for the specs.

Luxury.brandNameRationale: Sansovino frames — heavily carved, gilded, scrolled wood frames — are the 16th-century Venetian frame typology named after architect Jacopo Sansovino. The phrase places the brand directly in the Renaissance Venetian gilding tradition. Luxury bespoke framing, scholarly register.
Luxury.industrySummary: Luxury picture framing is dominated by anonymous workshops behind the major auction houses. The opening is for a named atelier with documented Renaissance-frame training — Sansovino, Florentine tabernacle, Whistler frames in the original tradition.
Luxury.competitorLandscape: Lowy 1907 (lowy1907.com) holds the US heritage-framing peer slot. John Davies Framing (johndavies.co.uk) plays the UK museum-grade peer. Eli Wilner & Company (eliwilner.com) is the US period-frame reference. We sit alongside Eli Wilner with a sharper Venetian specialty.
Luxury.positioningStatement: A luxury Renaissance-Venetian framing atelier producing Sansovino, tabernacle, and gilded period frames for collectors.

targetAudience.primary: 50 to 80. Owns significant historical paintings. Commissions period-correct framing.
behaviors: Commissions period-correct frames for historical paintings
Pays a premium for documented carved-and-gilt work
Travels to see the workshop in person

dos: Cite the Renaissance typology by name

Luxury.logoDirection: A serif wordmark — Sansovino House set in a classical Italian roman with a small carved-frame-corner silhouette beneath. Used on the commission certificate.

typography.secondary: Adobe Garamond for commissions and condition reports
typography.rationale: Sectra carries the scholarly register. Garamond keeps the long-form condition copy warm.

Minimal.brandNameRationale: Mitre is the single 45-degree corner joint that defines every frame. The trade vocabulary, single-syllable, period-locked. Minimal frame shop named on the one structural element common to every frame ever made.
Minimal.industrySummary: Minimal framing is rare in a category dominated by ornate options. The opening is for a frame shop named on a single piece of trade vocabulary, with a stripped catalog (one wood, one mat, one mount).
Minimal.competitorLandscape: Levenger (levenger.com) holds the minimal stationery-and-frame peer slot. Form Atelier (form-atelier.com) plays the minimal frame peer. Frame & Mount (frame-mount.com) is the trade-vocabulary peer. We sit further out — single-word brand, single-frame profile.
Minimal.positioningStatement: A minimal frame shop selling one wood, one mat, one mount.

targetAudience.primary: 30 to 55. Owns a small considered home. Wants frames that disappear, not present.
behaviors: Buys one frame profile across the home

dos: Show the mitre joint in raking light
Print the wood species and mat board grade

Minimal.logoDirection: Mitre set in a neutral grotesque, all lowercase, with a single 45-degree mitre-corner mark beneath. No second mark.

typography.primary: ABC Diatype for the wordmark and body
typography.secondary: ABC Diatype Mono for material specifications
typography.rationale: One family. Mono for the specs.

Corporate.tagline: Museum-grade framing and conservation, by contract.
Corporate.brandNameRationale: Archival is the conservation-grade material standard — acid-free, lignin-free, UV-glazed — required for institutional collections. Frame Partners names the B2B posture — multi-year contracts with museums, university collections, and corporate art programs.
Corporate.industrySummary: Corporate picture framing is a serious B2B category — museum-grade conservation framing for institutional collections, corporate art programs, and traveling exhibitions. The opening is for a mid-tier multi-institution framing partner with documented conservation standards.
Corporate.competitorLandscape: Bark Frameworks (barkframeworks.com) holds the US museum-grade peer slot. Atelier Sandnes (ateliersandnes.no) plays the European institutional peer. Conservation Framing (conservationframing.co.uk) is the UK trade-conservation reference. We sit alongside Bark with a sharper multi-institution-partner identity.
Corporate.positioningStatement: A corporate museum-grade framing partner for institutional collections, corporate art programs, and traveling exhibitions.

targetAudience.primary: Museum registrars, university collection managers, corporate art curators, and exhibition designers.
behaviors: Specifies framing to AIC conservation standards
Renews on three to five-year terms

dos: Speak the language of registrars and conservators

Corporate.logoDirection: A wordmark — ARCHIVAL in a tight grotesk above FRAME PARTNERS in tracked small caps. A single small frame-corner mark sits beside the wordmark on contract documents.

typography.secondary: Source Serif Pro for printed conservation reports
typography.rationale: Inter scales clean across digital. The serif handles printed conservation documentation.

Creative.tagline: Gold leaf meets the inside of the frame.
Creative.brandNameRationale: Pairs gilt (the gold-leaf tradition) with rabbet (the inside-back recess of the frame). Two trade-specific terms in conjunction — a creative-register frame shop with editorial storytelling around gilding and frame-making craft.
Creative.industrySummary: Creative picture framing is crowded with retail boutique shops. The opening is for a storytelling frame shop with a gilding specialty — gold-leaf restorations, Florentine and Venetian commissions, and editorial work for galleries and editorial spreads.
Creative.competitorLandscape: Julian Rouas Paris (julianrouas.com) holds the bespoke creative peer slot. Atelier Mériguet-Carrère (meriguet-carrere.com) plays the European gilt-decoration peer. APF Munn (apfmunn.com) is the US bespoke creative reference. We sit alongside APF Munn with a sharper editorial gilding identity.
Creative.positioningStatement: A creative gilding-and-framing studio producing bespoke gold-leaf frames, restorations, and editorial commissions.

targetAudience.primary: 35 to 60. Commissions one bespoke frame a year. Reads about frame history with interest.
behaviors: Pays a premium for hand-laid gold leaf

dos: Show the gold leaf being laid
Cite the frame typology by name

Creative.logoDirection: A wordmark — The Gilded Rabbet set in a calm editorial serif with a small gilded-corner silhouette beside it. The silhouette appears on commissions and the editorial print run.

typography.primary: GT Sectra for the wordmark and editorial prints
typography.secondary: Adobe Garamond for body and commissions
typography.rationale: Sectra carries the editorial register. Garamond keeps the long-form copy warm.
